en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a busy market square in a European town. Stalls and horse‑drawn carts fill the open square, with many people in early 20th‑century clothing. On the left stands a large baroque/renaissance town hall‑like building with an ornate façade and a tall church or town‑hall tower topped by a bulbous spire and cross. Surrounding the square are multi‑story gabled houses with steep tiled roofs. On the right are prominent hotels with large painted signs on their façades.
